name: Proposal for a decision
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION proposing the appointment of Maria Berger to the panel set up under Article 255 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union
part_text:
The European Parliament is asked to approve Maria Berger as a member of a panel set up under Article 255 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. This panel helps check the qualifications of people proposed as judges and advocates general at the Court of Justice of the European Union. The report says she meets the conditions the treaty sets for this role. Parliament is not changing any law here; it is giving its view on one appointment.

- Maria Berger would join the Article 255 panel that vets candidates for the Court of Justice.
- It affects her and the court's appointment checks; no law changes.
- Parliament's President would send the decision to the Court of Justice's President and the Council.
